item.name: Setup
item.description: Register a user, issue an API key, open an MCP session and list the tools.

request.description:
step: setup.user
label: Register user
kind: required

Registers a new ordinary user under a unique e-mail for this run and captures that e-mail.

step: setup.key
label: Issue API key
kind: required

Issues the API key the MCP calls authenticate with.

request.description:
step: setup.init
label: Initialize session
kind: required

Opens an MCP session and stores its id.

step: setup.initialized
label: Confirm session
kind: required

item.name: Advertisements
item.description: Create an advertisement over REST, read it through the MCP tools and delete it.

request.description:
step: ads.create
label: Create advertisement
kind: required

Creates an advertisement of the flow user and stores its id and version.

exec: const body = pm.response.text(); const rpc = JSON.parse(body.includes("data:") ? body.slice(body.lastIndexOf("data:") + 5) : body);
if (rpc.result.isError) { throw new Error("tool error: " + rpc.result.content[0].text); }

request.description:
step: ads.list
label: List advertisements
kind: required

Lists the advertisements without a filter.

exec: const body = pm.response.text(); const rpc = JSON.parse(body.includes("data:") ? body.slice(body.lastIndexOf("data:") + 5) : body);
if (rpc.result.isError) { throw new Error("tool error: " + rpc.result.content[0].text); }
if (!(rpc.result.structuredContent.totalCount === 1)) { throw new Error("expected totalCount 1 but got " + rpc.result.structuredContent.totalCount + ""); }

request.description:
step: ads.filter
label: Filter advertisements
kind: required

Filters by the title of the advertisement created above.

exec: const body = pm.response.text(); const rpc = JSON.parse(body.includes("data:") ? body.slice(body.lastIndexOf("data:") + 5) : body);
if (rpc.result.isError) { throw new Error("tool error: " + rpc.result.content[0].text); }
if (!(rpc.result.structuredContent.item.title === "MCP flow ad " + pm.collectionVariables.get("runId"))) { throw new Error("unexpected title"); }

request.description:
step: ads.get
label: Get advertisement
kind: required

Reads the advertisement created above.

exec: const body = pm.response.text(); const rpc = JSON.parse(body.includes("data:") ? body.slice(body.lastIndexOf("data:") + 5) : body);
if (rpc.result.isError) { throw new Error("tool error: " + rpc.result.content[0].text); }

request.description:
step: ads.media
label: List media
kind: required

Lists the media of the advertisement; it has none.

step: ads.delete
label: Delete advertisement
kind: optional

Deletes the advertisement using the stored version.
